title: PrPointer
description: pr-pointer@1 (02 §7, ADR 0004, ADR 0013): api/v1/pr/<number>/latest.json, a small mutable pointer to the latest run of a pull request's stream in history order. Readiness compares its bytes; the comment reconciler compares headSha with the pull request's current head.

headSha.description: The run's corroborated head commit (changes@1 source.headSha).
